scope: Spline no_pip_testdc acceptance only. 3D Bayesian phi_h in the copy of fits/spline/no_pip_testdc/no_pip_testdc/fit_copy.root, Q2-y 1-17, 452 histograms. The file has rdf, mdf, gdf, Background, and Bayesian histograms and no RC_Bayesian, BC_RC_Bayesian, Bin, or 5D histograms. Those families were not created. No publication. The source fit, the budget, and the shared Phi_h guides were not edited. This copy does not replace the source, so the source stays in the budget. The destination did not already contain refinement_note.json and fit.json, so this is not a resume.
start_mode: manual. start=auto: the 3D spline B windows selected by these histograms have median width 0.0153 and 428 of 452 are narrower than 0.05, and the C windows are narrower, so they can pin a fit. The run-local guide started as Phi_h_Fit_Parameters_Initialize.py. --use_spline_init was not passed.
changed: Pass 1 used the manual baseline on all 452 histograms. It improved 5 and made 18 worse. The worst was (Q2_y_Bin_10)-(z_pT_Bin_11), chi-squared 38.777 to 602.314, with B driven to -0.023 and a collapsed error. (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_8) moved only from the stored pin B=-0.045000 to B=-0.064158, C collapsed to 0, and chi-squared 55.397 to 53.878. That is still short of this histogram's cosine. Pass 2 put 49 starts on each histogram's own unconstrained cosine, opened only the limits that excluded that cosine, and turned off the second-pass half-width window when it was narrower than the parameter error. It refit Q2-y 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, and 17. Q2-y 4 and 8 were not given new keys. JSON still has 452 bins, including those two. 36 histograms have a lower chi-squared than the stored fit and none is worse (largest increase 0.001). (1, 8) is kept at B=-0.106076, statistical error 0.030770, C=-0.029715, error 0.028850, chi-squared 51.631, NDF 13, status completed, phi 60-300, 16 histogram bins inside the TF1 range. The stored B=-0.045 was the second-pass edge of a first-pass limit at -0.03, not the cosine. It is not pulled to the nominal B=-0.125184.
left_bins: No 5D family is in this file, so nothing was left from a 3D-versus-5D disagreement. Large nominal-minus-variation shifts that already match this histogram were not moved: (Q2_y_Bin_7)-(z_pT_Bin_35) B=-0.05324 versus nominal -0.24532; (Q2_y_Bin_3)-(z_pT_Bin_29) B=-0.097999 versus nominal -0.27991; (Q2_y_Bin_15)-(z_pT_Bin_24) B=-0.041786 and C=-0.074377; (Q2_y_Bin_12)-(z_pT_Bin_24) B=0.019950 and C=-0.122653; (Q2_y_Bin_8)-(z_pT_Bin_34) B=-0.004433 and C=-0.112937. (Q2_y_Bin_6)-(z_pT_Bin_6) stays at C=0.060000 because a wider limit changes chi-squared by only 0.058. (Q2_y_Bin_2)-(z_pT_Bin_21) keeps a collapsed cos(2phi) error because C is consistent with zero and the free cosine does not change the shape. That collapsed error is a stability note, not a smaller systematic uncertainty. Excluded sector pairs were not put back into this comparison. No comparison was filled with zero. The source was not removed from the budget, and fit-parameter errors were not added to the systematic uncertainty.
